mispricing.consensus_view: The market recognizes NVDA as the AI leader but worries that valuation, customer concentration, export controls, and future AI capex digestion limit forward upside.
mispricing.variant_view: NVDA's full-stack platform, backlog visibility, generation-over-generation cost-per-result advantage, and hyperscaler capex commitments make the earnings runway more durable than a normal semiconductor cycle.
mispricing.pricing_evidence: The thesis cites $215.9B FY26 revenue, $102.7B operating cash flow, a $4.58T market cap, 75.0% Q4 FY26 gross margins, and catalysts including Vera Rubin, May 20 earnings, hyperscaler capex, and Blackwell/Rubin backlog.
mispricing.why_consensus_is_wrong: Consensus may over-anchor on the size of the market cap and underweight how much demand visibility, software lock-in, supply pre-emption, and inference throughput improvements extend the runway.
